verdict.rationale: Obsidian's mobile page says the app has tabs, the Command Palette and plugins, which points to more than a stripped-down companion. The docs also describe a mobile editing toolbar and syncing the vault across devices via Obsidian Sync or third-party services. However, the evidence never confirms that search and linking work on mobile. A hands-on report also says the Android app doesn't save files until the note unloads, which can drop the last lines if a sync runs mid-edit. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of search and link/backlink navigation on iOS/Android, a documented statement of feature parity with desktop, independent corroboration of the full-featured mobile experience, and reliable Android save behavior during sync.
